value.title: Seat names stay clear of anything sensitive
value.summary: Sweep the memorable seat-name corpus and remove every word that could be read as offensive, sensitive, judgemental or trademarked, in both runtimes.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: On 2026-10-17 pij allocated the seat id pij-gay-thorn. Jordan: "we need to stay well clear of anything that might be subjectively examined". Seat ids are adjective-noun pairs (or a ship name) from a curated corpus vendored twice: crates/core/src/name_corpus.rs and .omp/extensions/pij/core/name-corpus.ts, with an EXCLUDED_NAME_WORDS list that is too narrow. Other ids seen this month: pij-controversial-guanaco, pij-crooked-thunderbluff, pij-additional-leeroy, pij-irregular-apocalypse; the ship list includes xenophobe, zealot, shoot-them-later, killing-time and jack-ketch. This plan sweeps every word conservatively and removes the risky ones in both runtimes.

sections.name: goals
value: No allocated seat id can be read as offensive, sensitive, judgemental, or as using someone else's trademark or character.
The two runtimes keep producing identical ids.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Renaming or closing existing seats (Jordan decides from assets/live-seats.md).
Changing the id format, hashing or allocation algorithm.
Adding new words to replace removed ones.

value.claim: Every word reviewed. assets/audit.md lists every entry of NAME_ADJECTIVES, NAME_NOUNS and SHIP_NAMES (crates/core/src/name_corpus.rs) that is removed, with its category, and states the total reviewed per list (it must equal the list length on main d48cde2). The bar is Jordan's: stay well clear of anything that might be subjectively examined. When in doubt, remove. Categories at minimum: sexuality, gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, politics, body parts and bodily functions, health, disability and mental state, age, appearance, weight; violence, weapons, killing, death, crime, punishment; drugs, alcohol, gambling; insults and character judgements (e.g. crooked, controversial, stupid); fear, disgust, shame; slang double meanings (including bird and animal names with a slang sense, e.g. tit, booby, cock, ass, beaver); trademarks, franchise or game names, and real or fictional people (e.g. thunderbluff, leeroy, the Culture-novel ship names); and any word that reads badly beside a common word of the other slot.

Removed in both runtimes, identically. Each removed word leaves crates/core/src/name_corpus.rs and .omp/extensions/pij/core/name-corpus.ts and is added to EXCLUDED_NAME_WORDS in both. The existing exclusion test also checks every hyphen-separated word of each ship name, not just the whole ship name, and every word from 'gay' (the reported case) and the audit appears in the exclusion list. The Rust↔TypeScript oracle test (crates/core/tests/memorable_ids.rs rust_matches_the_typescript_oracle) is regenerated as its comment says and passes.

Existing seats are unaffected. The coder shows (code citation plus a test or existing test) that a seat's id is stored at allocation and never recomputed from the corpus, so adopt, revive, send and close of an already-allocated id (including one whose words are now excluded) still work. If that is NOT true, stop and ask the prime before changing anything.

Live-fleet list for Jordan, read-only. assets/live-seats.md lists every seat currently known to the production daemon (`pij list --json`, read-only) whose id contains a now-excluded word. Nothing is renamed or closed; Jordan decides.

Proof. The strengthened exclusion test is shown RED on d48cde2 (quote: it names 'gay' and ship words) and green on the branch; one mutation receipt (re-add one excluded word to one runtime's list → the parity or exclusion test goes red → restore). cargo test -p pij-core, the TS memorable-id test, clippy, fmt and just lint pass; GitHub CI is green on the exact head; anything not run is NOT RUN with its reason.

value.title: Sweep the name corpus
value.brief: One phase: conservative audit of every word, removal plus exclusion in both runtimes, strengthened test red first, oracle regenerated, live-seat list, gates, PR. CS 2.
